item.title: Tailscale Integration for OpenBao
item.description: Plugin repository: https://github.com/SamPlaysKeys/openbao-plugin-secrets-tailscale This guide details how to set up an on-demand, dynamic Tailscale integration in OpenBao. When a client (such as a Docker container) requests a secret from docker/tailscale/auth-token/<name> (for example, docker/tailscale/auth-token/nginx), OpenBao will automatically call the Tailscale API to generate a short-lived, preauthorized, and ephemeral authentication key labeled for that specific container, returning it to the client immediately.
